claims: C1 the document section anchored #respect_creators, headed 'Respect creators and their rights', is assigned the authority level root
C2 every rule located under that heading therefore carries root authority

concepts.name: root_authority
concepts.gloss: R is assigned the authority level named root, the value the document's authority attribute carries on this section heading

concepts.name: rule_under_heading
concepts.gloss: the document places rule R inside the stretch of text that heading H opens -- after H and before the next heading of the same or higher level (first argument the rule, second the heading)
concepts.inference: the node speaks of the rules under a heading, so a relation between a rule and a heading must exist

concepts.name: respect_creators_heading
concepts.gloss: the document section opened by the heading 'Respect creators and their rights' and anchored #respect_creators

ontology.gloss: R is a rule under the #respect_creators heading and therefore carries the root authority level that heading is marked with
ontology.inference: the span writes authority=root on the section HEADING; that the assignment reaches each rule inside the section is the markup's scoping convention, which the document licenses and ESTABLISHES makes explicit, but the span itself does not state
